_what_this_is: Independently established results for the two recorded games the tracker acceptance pass replays. Nothing here was produced by the functions under test: the scores, line scores and batting/pitching lines come from the workbook the tracker .exe itself wrote when each game ended, the PA/run/matchup counts come from counting the tracker's own log lines, and the settlement amounts are arithmetic on the fixture's own wagers and payouts.

_oracles.workbook: sluggers-stat-tracker-advanced-stats-dev/output/<name>.xlsx, written by the tracker executable at the final out. It is deliberately NOT fed to the bridge during the replay (TRACKER_OUTPUT_DIR points at an empty directory), so it stays an independent observation.
_oracles.trackerLogCounts: grep counts over the saved session log: 'Plate appearance #' lines, 'recorded a run!' lines, and pitcher-vs-batter header lines.
_oracles.settlement: wager + payout on a win, wager refunded on a push, nothing on a loss (src/utils/betResolution.js's documented contract), applied by hand to the literal wagers in tests/helpers/trackerAcceptanceWorld.mjs.

workbookLineScore._audit: Game Info sheet rows 31-32. The log's own 'The Knights will bat first!' makes the Knights the away side, and the away side is team A on a site game row.

trackerLogCounts._audit: 83 pitcher-vs-batter headers: 78 real plate appearances, 4 headers the tracker repeated with no play under them, and 1 play (Red Noki, bottom 5th) whose outcome the tracker never stated.

persisted._audit_plateAppearances: 77 - 1 + 2 = 78. The tracker printed 77 'Plate appearance #' lines. One of those trips (Red Noki, bottom 5th) has no stated outcome, so the bridge refuses to score it. Two more trips the tracker never printed a line for at all (Wario, bottom 3rd; Green Paratroopa, bottom 7th) are in the log as complete plays — batter announced, ball hit, batter put out — and are recorded. The 83 pitcher-vs-batter headers are 78 written plate appearances plus 5 refusals: those four repeated headers with no play under them, and Red Noki's.
persisted._audit_runs: 17 rows against 18 'recorded a run!' lines. The eighteenth belongs to the Red Noki plate appearance the bridge refuses to score, and a run row cannot exist without its plate appearance. The scoreboard total is unaffected: the game row still reads 6-12.
persisted._audit_pitches: The tracker's own workbook totals 106 pitches (51 + 55). Its per-pitcher pitch and strike columns are internally inconsistent (its 'Strikes' column reads 2 of 25 for Luigi), so the exact total is not treated as an oracle; what is checked is that every persisted pitch is unique on (pa_id, pitch_number_pa) and that the per-pitcher totals are within one of the workbook's.
